title: A product page shows an outdated price

initial_facts.text: The product update succeeds, and the primary database stores the new price.
One API response still returns the previous price.

public_evidence.text: The primary database contains the new price for this product.
public_evidence.source: Synthetic primary read for request R-104

public_evidence.text: Request R-104 was served from a cache hit.
The reader looks up product:42:v7. The write invalidation deletes product:42.
public_evidence.source: Synthetic reader and invalidation key trace

public_evidence.text: The aggregate cache hit rate is within its usual range. This panel does not identify the key or value used by request R-104.

accepted_alternatives: Request the primary value and exact request trace before choosing a cause.
Retain multiple hypotheses and state what observation would distinguish them.
Conclude key mismatch only after comparing the request-specific lookup and invalidation keys.
